title: The Blading Revolution (1)
overview: The Hizashi brothers are ready to join a new Blading revolution! But before these two can take on Beyblade's biggest legends, they must create Lightning Beys of their very own.

title: Locked On! Lightning Launch! (1)
overview: Rantaro Kiyama has been asked to coach the Comets and teache Hyuga and Hikaru what Beyblade is all about.

title: Persistence! Kolossal Strike! (1)
overview: Granted official access to the National Training Center, Hyuga and Hikaru work hard to become A-Rank Bladers in time for the upcoming Legend Festival.

title: Listen to Your Bey's Voice! (1)
overview: Hyuga and Hikaru focus on forging connections with their Beys. To help them, Valt and Rantaro take them to meet a mysterious Blader.

title: Illusory Dragon! Mirage Fafnir! (1)
overview: After their loss to Free De La Hoya, Hikaru and Hyuga decide to follow the Blading Legend's training regimen to learn the secrets behind his success.

title: Dream Team! Tag Battle! (1)
overview: Arriving back in Japan, the brothers learn that spots in the Legend Festival are filling up fast. In order to rank up, Rantaro takes them to face a Beyblade ogre!

title: Conquering the Ogre's Dungeon! (1)
overview: Hyuga and Hikaru were no match for the legendary Blader Lui Shirosagi, but before the brothers can face Lui again, they have to conquer the Ogre's Dungeon.

title: The Jet-Black Sun! Vex Lucius! (1)
overview: Lain's Blading prowess seems to be the stuff of myth. But that doesn't matter to Hyugu - he's ready to go head-to-head anyway!

title: Is This a Dream?! Or Is It a Nightmare?! (1)
overview: While everyone's prepping for the Legend Festival, another hyperactive Blader rises up to challenge Hikaru and Hyuga!

title: Is This a Dream?! Or Is It a Nightmare?! (2)
Rise to Victory! Triumph Dragon! (1)
overview: Dante Koryu is itching to battle the Hizashi brothers, and Hyuga is up first!

title: The Great Revolution! Legend Festival! (1)
overview: With the curtains finally open on the Legend Festival, Blading legends and challengers alike are gathered for the ultimate showdown.

title: Hyuga and Lain vs Hikaru and Aiger! (1)
overview: Participants in the Legend Festival are off to compete in the second stage! Next up is a series of team battles starting with Hyuga and Lain taking on Hikaru and Aiger!

title: Hyuga and Lain vs. Hikaru and Aiger! (2)
A True Hero! Tag Battle Style! (1)
overview: When Hikaru and Rantaro go up against Dante and Lui, one thing is clear: they'd better hope their teamwork is enough to win!

title: A True Hero! Tag Battle Style! (2)
Gotta Win! Going All-Out! (1)
overview: Legends and challengers alike are going all-out for a chance to show everyone what they can really do. All eyes are on Hyuga and Valt as they take on Free and Lui to do just that.

title: Defeat Valt! (1)
overview: With his semi-final match against Valt approaching fast, Hyuga hardly has any time left to prepare! Luckily, Hikaru comes to the rescue with a training strategy.

title: Grand Finale! Valt vs. Lain! (1)
overview: With Lain's Flare growing stronger, it looks like Valt's the only one who can take him down. There's no telling what the future holds as challenger and Legend go head-to-head.

title: Spirit of Fire! World Spryzen! (1)
overview: It seems like no one can stop Lain! That is, until Shu steps in. Can Shu reach Lain before he's swallowed up by his Flare, or will Lain carry out his vow and defeat his mentor?

title: Spirit of Fire! World Spryzen (2)
overview: Lain's getting so strong it seems like no one can stop him, except for Shu.

title: Counterattack! Lucius Endbringer! (1)
overview: Frustrated by his loss to Shu, Lain evolves Lucius and challenges Shu to a rematch. How will Spryzen hold up against the evolved Lucius Endbringer?

title: Tag-Team! Ultimate Partner! (1)
overview: It's time to pair up for the Ultimate Tag Series! Hikaru's set on teaming up with Aiger, while Hyuga's raring to battle alongside Valt.

title: Raging Battle! Defeating the Storm! (1)
overview: The tag-teams are set for the Ultimate Tag Series. While Dante and Lui clash with Valt and Honcho, Hikaru and Hyuga learn that the Blading legends are full of surprises.

title: Crash and Clash! Battle of Legends! (1)
overview: The Hizashi brothers are up against some of the strongest Bladers ever, and if they want to win, they'll need to work together!

title: Crash and Clash! Battle of Legends! (2)
Friendly Fire? Final Limit Breaker! (1)
overview: Tension starts to brew between Lain and Shu. Meanwhile, Wakiya invites the Hizashi brothers over for an unconventional meet-up with some other Bladers.

title: Scorching Battle! Dauntless Bravery! (1)
overview: With Round 4 wrapping up fast, Lain and Shu are just one win away from securing their place in the finals!

title: We Can Do It! Or Maybe Not! (1)
overview: In Round 5, Hyuga and Hikaru are going up against Free and Silas.

title: We Can Do It! Or Maybe Not! (2)
Confidence! Cowardice? Carefree-ness?! (1)
overview: As the Ultimate Tag Series hits the semi-finals, Hyuga and Hikaru go up against the legendary Valt Aoi and Rantaro Kiyama.

title: Revolution! The Final Showdown! (1)
overview: The finale of the Ultimate Tag Series is here, and no one can look away for a second! Hyuga and Hikaru might just have what it takes to defeat Lain and Shu.
